changed: Eight ERP task definitions plus a read-only assistant definition, packaged as resources under plugins/erp/domain/tasks/ (shipped in the domain-erp wheel), declared in the pack manifest and built from the Phase 1d task presets (task_id = preset kind, D8). Each definition has a narrowed capability subset recorded in tests/unit/plugins/erp/domain/golden/task_capabilities.json against today's single tool set. Acceptance is disjunctive (every required effect verified, or the required answer verified; AcceptanceSpec docstring); draft-po accepts its verified draft PO or the verified zero-shortage answer. Registry admission refuses an unadmitted capability, a duplicate task_id, a widening budget (model_fields_set, D7) and, in live profiles, a write capability or binding with a defaulted effect declaration; fixture profiles report defaults; a pack without definitions still loads. The registry copies BindingTemplate.idempotency into CapabilityBinding only when declared. ERP and Odoo manifests declare effects; the four Odoo write bindings declare provider_key because the bridge dedupes on a UNIQUE operation reservation (re-send stays off in Phase 2). Pins re-pinned. Commits a6ff19c, 22ca83e. Review: controller C-1 (acceptance read as conjunctive) fixed; Claude review (Codex rate-limited) accept with six Low findings.
